description: Classification and handling policy for duplicate customizations.

provider-link.description: Symlink or junction pointing to canonical folder. Keep or repair if broken.

duplicate-copy.description: Same content copied to another location. Remove only with dry-run plan and backup.

stale-cache.description: Old generated/cached artifact that can be rebuilt.

conflict.description: Same name but different content across locations. Never auto-delete.

broken-link.description: Symlink/junction whose target does not exist.

unknown.description: Customization that does not match any known pattern.

rules: Never delete unknown or conflicting customizations silently.
Always produce a dry-run plan before any mutation.
Quarantine risky removals to a timestamped backup folder before deletion.
Use content hashing (SHA-256) to distinguish identical from conflicting duplicates.
Resolve all paths to absolute before comparison.
